name: 左写真付きの記事一覧行
prompt:
Create a standalone left-photo article list row at the exact proportions of the source crop (974 x 307 px). Use the attached exact article thumbnail as the reference for the left-side image; keep it rectangular and uncropped. The text column begins to its right with a clear gap, aligned near the top. Use a clean white background, a bold dark Japanese headline across exactly two lines, and a muted gray reading-time line below it. Match the native Japanese preview for exact words, Japanese sans-serif style, and editorial hierarchy.
Headline, exactly:
対話から始まる、
新しいまちの物語

Reading time, exactly:
読了まで5分

Keep the thumbnail at about 292 x 296 px, positioned at x=0 and y=4 in the target image; begin the text near x=340. Do not include the English source text, buttons, icons, or other content. Do not invent or alter the article photograph.
reviewNotes: v001を目視確認して候補登録。日本語プレビューの見出しと読了時間を再現し、写真は確認済みの292×296元アセットを原寸・無損失で合成（全画素差分0）。候補全体は参照領域の974×307に一致。ネイティブ実装の承認とは別。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
